test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between K and L. L sits third to the right of M. Only three people sit between I and J. I sits to the immediate right of K. If no other person is sitting in the row, how many people are there in total?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) L sits third to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82465a1221af2e0a0baed1626776b8600cb531160b7e74857147447962ec3aa6.png] 

2) Only two people sit between K and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d3f64591a93ce143b6fc73e38d99597bdc456926cdb356c6b8c595f160b072b.png] 

3) I sits to the immediate right of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/865f964dbb8909f7f2e1be6347cf6ed7057c4e67c6c28a50938932f75bef8d5f.png] 

4) Only three people sit between I and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b7e93f29a26a58bbe76d3138a3eb87ee75d710bc830b7b64e0d3dc8a2037c6e.png] 

Here, we can see that there are twelve people.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Twelve"**.
